scope: One server-side connection, bounded latest-value cache, and normalized per-screen public display snapshots; source attribution retained.
published_guidance: No. Direct browser connections are not permitted. Connect from your own server and proxy only the information your clients need. This protects the API key and reduces load on the stream service.
interpretation: The limited display proxy follows the published application guidance. Temporary latest-value caching implements that proxy; the guidance does not grant an open data licence, archival redistribution or resale rights.
restrictions: No raw WebSocket relay or bulk dataset export
No public historical tracks or replay
No claim to an open-data licence
unresolved: No separate data licence or general caching/redistribution terms were found. Broader licensing questions remain unanswered in official issues 68 and 290.
